short_description.value: TerraFM is a scalable self-supervised foundation model for unified multisensor Earth observation, leveraging globally distributed Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 imagery with large spatial tiles and land-cover aware sampling. It unifies radar and optical inputs via modality-specific patch embeddings and adaptive cross-attention fusion, and introduces dual-centering for class-frequency-aware regularization. TerraFM achieves state-of-the-art results on GEO-Bench and Copernicus-Bench for classification and segmentation tasks.

pretext_training_type.value: Self-supervised contrastive learning (DINO-style) with dual centering

masking_strategy.value: No explicit masking; contrastive learning with multi-crop and modality augmentation

pretraining.value: Contrastive learning with DINO framework, modality-specific patch embeddings, cross-attention fusion, and dual-centering for class-frequency-aware regularization. Pretrained on globally distributed Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 imagery using large tiles and land-cover aware sampling.

value.value: Global distributional priors (land cover, climate zones, ESRI world regions)

missing_data.value: Tiles with consistent coverage across all three modalities selected
